import random, string, re, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

# Load updated module
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('textmask', '/work/textmask.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

# Pre-refactor behavior for comparison

def old_masked(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

# Deterministic spot checks
cases = [
    ("Hello Foo-Bar baz foo bar foobar", "foo-bar"),
    ("ABC abc a-b-c", "a-b-c"),
    ("name with hyphen my-skill-name and MY-SKILL-NAME", "my-skill-name"),
    ("xx aaa aa a", "aaa-aa-a"),
    ("C++ token c++ token", "c++-token"),
]

for text, name in cases:
    n = mod.masked(text, name)
    o = old_masked(text, name)
    assert n == o, (text, name, o, n)

# Randomized checks
alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + '-_+ '
for _ in range(500):
    name_parts = []
    for _ in range(random.randint(1,5)):
        part_len = random.randint(1,8)
        part = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits + '+_') for _ in range(part_len))
        name_parts.append(part)
    name = '-'.join(name_parts)

    text_len = random.randint(0,120)
    text = ''.join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(text_len))

    o = old_masked(text, name)
    n = mod.masked(text, name)
    if o != n:
        raise AssertionError((text, name, o, n))

# Structural check: only import re and two def names
src = Path('/work/textmask.py').read_text()
assert 'import re' in src
assert src.count('def ') == 2
assert 'def name_tokens' in src and 'def masked' in src
